attack_techniques: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder (T1547.001)
attackers_goals: Maintain persistence on the host through automatic execution at startup.
description: An uncommon file was created in the startup folder.
investigative_actions: Determine if the file was created as part of a legitimate application installation, and check other files written by the same process. Identify which program opens this file based on its extension. Check the registry at HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT[extension]\shell[action]\command to see the default application or command used to execute the file.
name: An uncommon file was created in the startup folder
